sqls.title: VIEW - table references
sqls.description: Obtains metadata for VIEW. It includes columns, referenced tables and definition. Useful in case of debugging lock issues when waiting transaction concerns some view.

sqls.title: FOREIGN KEY - table references
sqls.description: Obtains metadata for FOREIGN KEYS. It includes name of the referenced table and the nature of the constraints.

sqls.title: INDEX - general info
sqls.description: Obtains metadata for INDEX. It includes general information about the index (if it's PK/UNIQUE constraint based)

sql_file.title: INDEX - column info
sql_file.description: Obtains metadata for INDEX. It dumps information about the ordinals of the column.
